blog.title: Running Speech AI On-Device: Model Compression & Chromium
blog.excerpt: A technical breakdown on compiling and running optimized speech-to-text models on low-power mobile devices and Chromium-based engines.
blog.content: On-device AI is crucial for privacy and low-latency interaction. In this post, we discuss compiling speech-to-text models for JioSphere browser cross-device execution. We explore quantization (INT8), pruning weights, and writing lightweight JS integrations for Chromium. We achieve a 4x reduction in model footprint with minimal word-error-rate increases.

blog.title: SCTE-35 Signal Parsing at Scale: IPL 2023 Live Ads
blog.excerpt: How we monitored and processed stream markers across 17 feeds and 12 languages for 32 Million concurrent viewers on JioCinema.
blog.content: IPL 2023 set record metrics. Parsing SCTE-35 markers in live transport streams with microsecond precision is vital for inserting targeted ads. This post outlines our pipeline architecture, how we parsed splicing command markers, handled regional feeds, and generated opportunity loss telemetry data in real-time.

linkedinPosts.content:
Excited to share that we just successfully completed IPL 2023 live ad operations on JioCinema! 🚀

To support our peak concurrent viewership of 32M+ viewers, we built real-time ad delivery monitoring across 12 languages and 17 streams using SCTE-35 signal parsing. By creating an automated telemetry dashboard for Ad Opportunity Loss, we were able to pinpoint stream drops instantly and save millions in potential lost revenue.

Huge shoutout to the engineering teams at Reliance Jio and Quest Global for making this historic season happen! 🏆

Humbled to receive the Top Partner Employee award for my contributions to the JioAds ecosystem! 🏅

Over the past year, we have been building a GenAI Ad Creative Platform designed to help small and medium businesses (SMBs) automatically generate high-quality audio, video, and image-based ad creatives. Seeing this pipeline scale to Jio's 450M+ consumer base has been an incredible journey. 

Looking forward to pushing the boundaries of multimodal GenAI even further! 💡

On-device AI is moving fast! 📲

We are currently developing a cross-device on-device Speech AI pipeline for the JioSphere browser. By applying model compression (INT8 quantization, structural pruning) and memory optimization, we've successfully integrated high-performance speech-to-text models directly into the browser engine. This eliminates server hops, reduces costs, and provides near-zero latency while maintaining user privacy.

Read more details in my latest technical article or try it out in the JioSphere browser app! 🌐
